entries.title: Cards show the message they answer
entries.body: A card about something you asked now shows your message under its title, with when you sent it, on your Mac and your iPhone or iPad. A long message shows its first two lines, and Show all opens the rest. When work moves to a new task, its cards still show your first message.

picture.alt: A first mate card titled Yes: a card you replied under keeps its place, with You asked and the captain's question under its title
